onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/force_response.schema.json, set fc_c_bounce to {{fc_c_bounce}}]
Set restitution preset to {{fc_c_bounce}}: none=restitution 0.0, slight=0.2, bouncy=0.7.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/force_response.schema.json, set fc_t_mass to {{fc_t_mass}}]
Set CharacterForceControllerBase.mass to {{fc_t_mass}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/physics/properties/force_response.schema.json, set fc_t_restitution to {{fc_t_restitution}}]
Set KinematicForceController.restitution to {{fc_t_restitution}}. 0=no bounce, 1=full bounce.
